meta.description: Eval set for the CHOICE bucket matching pipeline (Phase 6 of CLAUDE_CODE_BUILD_BRIEF.md). 18 realistic objective statements spanning different domains, each with a human-labeled set of buckets that SHOULD reasonably appear in the top-5 tooltip. Use to measure precision/recall before shipping, and any time bucket_library.json's synonym lists change.
meta.how_to_score: For each test case, run the statement through the matching pipeline, take its top-5 predicted buckets, and compare to expected_buckets. A 'hit' is any predicted bucket whose base name (ignore _v2/tier suffixes) matches an expected bucket name. Report hits/misses per case, then aggregate precision (hits / 5) and recall (hits / len(expected_buckets)) across all 18 cases.
